card.wx.descCompose.text:
(descriptor, phenom) =>
      descriptor === "showers"
        ? phenom === ""
          ? "showers (type indistinguishable)"
          : `${phenom} showers`
        : phenom === ""
          ? descriptor
          : `${descriptor} ${phenom}`

card.ago.text:
(minutes) =>
      minutes < 60
        ? ` (${minutes} min ago)`
        : minutes < 48 * 60
          ? ` (${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} h ago)`
          : ` (${Math.floor(minutes / 1440)} d ago)`
